title: Layer 2 round 3 minor QE: a stderr-only pipe holdout fails a clean successful run as TimedOut, contradicting the declared best-effort stderr posture

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 870836ce: the stderr collection is unconditional best-effort — recv_timeout's breach or loss yields an empty buffer, never TimedOut, so a descendant holding only the stderr write-end past a clean exit leaves the acquired run acquired. TimedOut remains for the data-bearing waits (the child and stdout). The module doc's garnish posture and the code now agree.
